شِعْرَةٌ The hair of the pubes; (T, Msb, K;) as also ↓ شِعْرَآء , [accord. to general analogy with tenween,] or ↓ شَعْرَآء , [and if so, without tenween,] accord to different copies of the K; (TA;) of a man and of a woman; and of the hinder part of a woman: (T, Msb:) or the hair of the pubes of a woman, specially: (S, O, Msb:) and the pubes (عَانَة) [itself]: (K:) and the place of growth of the hair beneath the navel. (K, * TA.) ―
-b2- Also A portion of hair. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
